dataset.feedComposition: Load registered assay and persist its ordered component IDs and full flow vector before executing either revision.

execution.screenWorkerMode: Isolated JVM processes; one CPU solve at a time in each; 12 is the combined cap across both revisions.
execution.screenWorkerSizing: min(12, floor((availableMemoryGiB - 6)/2)); round down to even for equal revision pools, falling back to one serial worker if needed
